images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Top-down exploration game in total darkness. The left two-thirds of the screen is pure black cave; at its center a tiny warm amber dot marks the player, labeled '나'. A thin cyan sonar ring expands from the player after a hand clap, clipped by line of sight, and wherever it touches rock the cave walls flare up as glowing cyan outlines with soft bloom, then fade to faint remembered lines; small secondary ripples bounce back from the walls. A dim dotted ellipse on the far left hints at a shallow puddle. The right third is a warm lamp-lit desk surface with a pinned aged parchment map: hand-inked cave walls with cross-hatching toward the rock, red dashed measurement lines from a red X with distances '5.3m' and '12.2m', a feather quill actively inking a new wall segment, compass rose, title cartouche '물방울 회랑'. Below the map a dark notebook log of echo times. Bottom-left: three tool cards '손뼉', '호루라기', '돌 던지기', and an oscilloscope-style echo waveform strip. Top: thin elegant title '메아리 지도 제작자'. Palette: void black, sonar cyan, parchment sepia, faint amber; fine film grain, vignette. Correction: echo times must match distance = 343 m/s × time ÷ 2. The notebook log shows exactly these rows: 01 손뼉 0.031s 5.3m, 02 손뼉 0.071s 12.2m, 03 호루라기 0.105s 18.0m, 04 돌 던지기 0.200s 34.3m, and the waveform strip peaks are labeled 0.031s, 0.071s, 0.105s, 0.200s; no other time/distance pairs.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Same top-down darkness game at its climax: the player, a small amber dot labeled '나', stands just inside an enormous cavern and has blown a whistle. Several thick concentric cyan rings sweep outward, and the whole domed hall flares into view as bright glowing cyan wall outlines about forty meters across, stalagmites casting occlusion gaps in the rings. In the middle a large underground lake rendered as a dotted ellipse filled with shimmering horizontal blue ripple lines. Near the top a jagged crack in the ceiling glows red-orange, fine dust specks falling from it, and a swarm of small white bat silhouettes scatters. A red warning bar reads '천장 균열'. Faint large spaced lettering over the hall reads '대공동'. HUD: '천장 안정도 21%' in red, the '호루라기' tool card outlined in red, echo waveform with a long decaying tail. Right third: parchment map almost complete, lake washed in blue watercolor labeled '잠든 호수', red ink note on the ceiling crack. Palette: black, cyan, danger red, sepia; grain, slight camera shake feel. Correction: keep the exact top-down camera of image A — the cave is pure black and becomes visible only as thin glowing cyan outlines where the sonar rings hit; no perspective 3D cavern render, no lit rock surfaces. The tool tray shows exactly three cards '손뼉', '호루라기' (selected, red outline), '돌 던지기' — no torch, rope, pickaxe or any light source.
